newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Filipino workers welcomed the lifting of an employment ban in Saudi Arabia.
- The Saudi Commerce Ministry discovered fake watches worth five million riyals.
- Saudi Arabia extended soft loans worth 262.2 billion riyals to citizens in the past 25 years.
- A Saudi-Yemeni border committee held a meeting in Riyadh.
- A British team discussed setting up joint projects with Saudi businessmen.
- There are 472 petrochemical plants investing 110 billion riyals in Saudi Arabia, the industry ministry said.
